Use `MASTER_INSTRUCTIONS.md` as the shared rule set and `CLAUDE.md` as the binding session rules; both apply to Copilot. Before material work, read `CLAUDE.md`, `PROMPTS.md`, `README.md` and `BRANCH_RETENTION.md`, and stay inside the paths your session owns. Change `contracts/` first when an interface must change. Avoid secrets, make the smallest defensible change, and validate it with `python tools/validate_boundaries.py` and the focused tests in `docs/workflow-migration/WINDOWS_QUICKSTART.md`. Never run `tests/test_workflow_approval.py` directly. Do not perform consequential external writes without explicit authority.

Before autonomous substantive work, run `python -B scripts/validate_workflow_approval.py --fingerprint --require-active`. A failure or an unavailable runtime means autonomy stays off. A pass approves bounded offline work only: no paid calls, no merge. Never edit the approval-frozen files named in `MASTER_INSTRUCTIONS.md`, and never delete, rename, reset or force-push a branch.
